title: Coffee - Worldwide
highlights: Revenue, at home (e.g., revenue generated in supermarkets and convenience stores) in the Coffee market amounts to US$108.06bn in 2026.
Revenue, out-of-home (e.g., revenue generated in restaurants and bars) amounts to US$413.82bn in 2026.
Revenue, combined amounts to US$521.87bn in 2026.
The revenue, at home is expected to grow annually by 3.29% (CAGR 2026-2031).
In global comparison, most revenue, at home is generated United States (US$14bn in 2026).
In relation to total population figures, the average revenue per capita, at home of US$13.67 are generated in 2026.
In the Coffee market, volume, at home is expected to amount to 5.94bn kg by 2026.
Volume, out-of-home is expected to amount to 1.26bn kg in 2026.
Volume, combined is expected to amount to 7.20bn kg in 2026.
The Coffee market is expected to show a volume growth, at home of 0.1% in 2027.
The average volume per person, at home in the Coffee market is expected to amount to 0.75kg in 2026.
